_about: Hand-written HTML lessons for physics. Each is lessons/<file>.html (the header and article only; the site adds navigation, contents and the pager). Problem sets are lessons whose article has class "lesson problems"; the problem book gathers them. Links inside them are written from the site root, like /physics/P1-mechanics/.

lessons.title: Problem set: mechanics
lessons.blurb: Fourteen problems: dimensional analysis, the skier on the dome, the rocket equation, rolling races, the bead on a spinning hoop, the pendulum's real period, adiabatic invariants, the tennis racket theorem, tides and Foucault's pendulum.

lessons.title: Problem set: waves and electromagnetism
lessons.blurb: Thirteen problems: strings and d'Alembert, Doppler, the blue sky, a tunnel through the Earth, image charges, the capacitor's half-energy tax, the infinite resistor grid, light from Maxwell, solar sails and the collapsing classical atom.

lessons.title: Problem set: heat and statistical physics
lessons.blurb: Twelve problems: kinetic theory, Maxwell's speeds, scale heights and lapse rates, Carnot's bound, Gibbs's paradox, negative temperatures, frozen vibrations, the Einstein solid, Stefan–Boltzmann from Planck, and the price of erasing a bit.

lessons.title: Problem set: relativity and quantum physics
lessons.blurb: Thirteen problems: the light clock, muons, velocity addition, the twin paradox by birthday cards, pion decay, the antiproton threshold, Compton scattering, the size of atoms, tunnelling, three polarisers and the Fermi sea.
